### How It Works
- **C Preprocessor (`gcc`)**: Uses `#if 0 ... #endif` blocks to skip the Python implementation and the closing Python docstring delimiter, while keeping all quotes balanced on single lines (`r""" "` and `""" # "`) so the C tokenizer never encounters an unterminated string literal.
- **Python (`python3`)**: Treats `#if 0` and `#endif` as comments and wraps the C code inside a raw triple-quoted string (`r""" " ... """ # "`).
- **Fibonacci Implementation**: Both [`fib`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-zjym43fq/polyglot/main.py.c#L6-L10) (Python) and [`main`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-zjym43fq/polyglot/main.py.c#L23-L64) (C, using base-$10^9$ big integers) compute $f(N)$ iteratively with arbitrary precision so they match for both small and large $N$.
